# GoHard semantic-error oracle (#34, R12): corpus-mode_views.txt.
# Written by go run ./tools/oracle --update semerr; do not edit.
# Each "run" is one analysis group of the project's own driver (a
# testsuite.sh between cleans, a VESTS list, an NVC regression test or
# unit-test block, a corpus design run, or a file no driver names,
# alone under 2008): its files are analyzed in order, one command per
# file, in a fresh work directory per tool ("dir" is the working
# directory; the run's GHDL --std and the sha256 prefix of its sources
# follow). Each file line is the argument, the library when not work,
# the GHDL options, then per tool the exit code and the lines of that
# file it reports errors on; "~" marks a line whose only errors are
# cascades (GHDL's "<unit> was not analysed", NVC's "... was analysed
# with errors"). tools/oracle checks that GoHard reports an error on
# every line both tools report one on, cascades aside
# (semerr_check.go).
tool ghdl 6.0.0
tool nvc 1.23.0
run corpus:mode_views:main dir=testdata/corpus/mode_views std=19 define=MV_PROFILE=wide sha=34b8dea5e9db344a
 mode_views_pkg.vhd ghdl=1@26,28,30,33,35,37,38,39 nvc=0
 mode_views.vhd ghdl=1@6,11,15~,37,42,48~,72,82~ nvc=0
 mode_views_tb.vhd ghdl=1@5,10~ nvc=0
run corpus:mode_views:define_narrow dir=testdata/corpus/mode_views std=19 define=MV_PROFILE=narrow sha=34b8dea5e9db344a
 mode_views_pkg.vhd ghdl=1@26,28,30,33,35,37,38,39 nvc=0
